samples.identification: Cobalt Strike x86 reflective DNS Beacon (SA signature)
evidence: DOS-header bootstrap calls raw offset 0x7f2d; returned entry is called with reason 4. The ReflectiveLoader export maps sections, resolves imports using ROR13 export hashes, applies relocations, sets executable permissions, and calls DllMain.
e_lfanew=0xe8 points to SA rather than PE. Loader function at preferred VA 0x10008d6d explicitly searches for MZ and SA, so the altered signature is intentional.

Preferred VA 0x1000a4de initializes the settings table, including a 4096-byte XOR-0x2e loop at 0x1000a51d. Stored settings at raw offset 0x30c20 have an additional repeating mask; effective 12-byte XOR 2a916b7667110161122a916b recovers a consistent typed table through its terminator.
Recovered settings: DNS mode=1, port=53, polling=3000ms, jitter=50, DNS idle=0, configured host ns1.goporsche.de, path /jquery.com/, RSA public key, and x86/x64 PrintIsolationHost.exe spawn targets.

DNS loop at 0x10003498 constructs check-ins, interprets the F0 control word and fetch-mode bits, retrieves task bytes through A/AAAA/TXT paths, verifies/decrypts returned data at 0x10009f32, and passes records via 0x1000866d to the opcode jump table at 0x10008179.

Query wrapper 0x1000277e calls DnsQuery_A via import ordinal 1 in DNSAPI.dll. Remote execution helpers contain live WriteProcessMemory calls at 0x10003c49, 0x10005744, 0x10005890, 0x10005b1c and CreateRemoteThread calls at 0x100058fd and 0x1000596d. CreateProcessA is called at 0x10003ffe.
The mapped-header copy routine can zero the mapped PE signature, MZ word and e_lfanew. x64 export-hash shellcode is also embedded in this x86 image.
limitations: No sample code was executed and no live C2 was contacted. Recorded VAs use the preferred image base 0x10000000.

The first image's additional config mask is decoded by a consistent table-level transform; the in-image initialization path still expects the standard 0x2e layer. The location of an additional unmasking step or required predecessor is unresolved. Do not claim successful autonomous check-in from these bytes.

Cobalt Strike can be authorized testing software. No engagement authorization or deployment context was supplied; hostile provenance, configured covert tasking and injection packaging tip this artifact toward malicious.

samples.identification: Cobalt Strike x86 reflective DNS Beacon (TL signature)
evidence: DOS-header bootstrap calls raw offset 0x9436, the ReflectiveLoader export; bootstrap then calls the returned entry with reason 4.
e_lfanew=0x100 points to TL rather than PE. This is another intentionally modified, manually loaded PE image, with DNS Beacon implementation matching the first sample.

Settings table at raw offset 0x33a20 decodes with XOR 0x2e: DNS mode=1, port=53, polling=10000ms, jitter=0, DNS idle=8.4.4.4, configured host ns1.blueorbits.site and /api/v1/telemetry. The table contains an RSA public key, wmiprvse.exe and msedge.exe spawn targets, DNS label prefixes, and injection settings.

The DNS task-word/flag branch has the same instruction structure as sample 1, at raw offset 0x3a1b. Both numbered single-label and four-label hex framing templates are present, along with native DNS imports by ordinal. The task loop and command dispatch are part of the executable implementation, not only strings.
The PE imports and code contain remote-memory writes, remote-thread/context manipulation, token impersonation, process launch and filesystem command handlers.
limitations: No code execution or live C2 observation. Native APIs and command handlers establish capabilities; they do not establish that every optional task ran.
No authorized assessment context was provided. External hostile provenance plus configured covert tasking and reflective injection tips the judgment to malicious.

evidence: All 92 bytes were inspected, including the ending newline. Only html/body/h1 markup and a plain timeout explanation are present.
No script, event handler, executable object, redirect, external URL, dependency, encoded payload or hidden trailing data is present. Browser behavior is limited to rendering the error text.

There are no referenced dependencies or URLs to fetch. The queue label plausibly reflects an error response collected from a hostile URL rather than the intended payload. Its original request URL was not supplied.
limitations: The server that produced this body and its intended upstream content cannot be inferred from the response body alone.

rule_changes: Add a DNS-tasking implementation composite requiring two distinct framing templates, control-word/flag code and the DNSAPI library. Require all separate roles; no endpoint, campaign name or exact file size is used.

Tighten the MZRE Beacon family composite with DNS-tasking evidence and the bootstrap. Move header-plus-ReflectiveLoader evidence to neutral dylib/load/runtime; remove the weak MZRE+HTTP+pipe family primitive. This intentionally stops the family claim on generic reflective-loader carriers.

Move DNSAPI.dll name evidence from dns/lookup to fs/path/library; raise to notable and use raw matching so malformed PE import recovery is unnecessary. No exact YAML consumers used the old ID. Broad lookup selectors intentionally lose an unsupported lookup inference.
Treat MZRE magic as a notable structural fact. Describe parser-error counts as diagnostics instead of claiming a malformed section layout.
Suppress missing-import/signature claims when PE parsing is incomplete; repaired analysis copies prove these original images do have the supposedly absent imports.

Raise the complete Toolhelp API name observation to notable, with a baseline downgrade for the standard Go Windows runtime LazyProc name found even in do-nothing programs; add direction-neutral 4096-byte XOR-buffer transformation detection.

validation.scan_caveat: atomscan 2.13.0's embedded analyzer reports both altered images as unknown and emits only decoding leads. The newer installed cleave recognizes the PE fallback and fires both local hostile traits on the original bytes. A YAML rule cannot make the older embedded analyzer route unknown files through PE analysis; this engine limitation is retained explicitly.
validation.final_gate: make validate is run as the final action after markers and scans.
validation.first_gate_correction: Initial validation rejected notable Toolhelp name evidence on Go do-nothing fixtures; the runtime-specific baseline downgrade retains the accurate observation.

reference_audit.consumers: The two removed family atoms had only the carrier composite as exact consumer. DNSAPI DLL had no exact YAML consumers. Parent selectors were reviewed: neutral evidence no longer contributes family identity or DNS lookup; carrier detection is intentionally tightened.
reference_audit.placement: DNS tasking stays in the existing dns/tunneling leaf under the taxonomy's open DNS disposition. No new sibling partition is created. Other new rules use existing operation/resource leaves.
